title: Jubilant Crispy Polish Whole Wheat Pilaf
description: A malty, crispy, and light Polish dish featuring whole wheat, this pilaf is perfect for a weeknight dinner, and its ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients make it a great option for those looking for a healthy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the grated carrots and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the whole wheat and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the water, malt syrup, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the pilaf is crispy and golden brown.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
